```yaml
name: Claude Review

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test-cli:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.10
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -e .
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi

      - name: Run script with CLI args
        env:
          ACCOUNT: test_account
          PARTITION: test_partition
          NEMORUN_HOME: /tmp/nemorun_home
          CUSTOM_MOUNTS: /tmp/custom_mounts
        run: |
          set -e
          echo "Running evaluation_with_nemo_run.py with explicit CLI arguments"
          python scripts/evaluation_with_nemo_run.py \
            --slurm \
            --account $ACCOUNT \
            --partition $PARTITION \
            --job_dir $NEMORUN_HOME \
            --custom_mounts $CUSTOM_MOUNTS

      - name: Run script with env var fallbacks
        env:
          ACCOUNT: env_account
          PARTITION: env_partition
          NEMORUN_HOME: /tmp/nemorun_home_env
          CUSTOM_MOUNTS: /tmp/custom_mounts_env
        run: |
          set -e
          echo "Running evaluation_with_nemo_run.py relying on environment variable fallbacks"
          python scripts/evaluation_with_nemo_run.py \
            --slurm \
            --job_dir $NEMORUN_HOME \
            --custom_mounts $CUSTOM_MOUNTS

      - name: Teardown
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/teardown-linux@main
        with:
          skip-wait-ssh: true
```
